messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick handoff — OrionData closed last night, ARR $120k. They want a dedicated deployment in us-west, go-live target ~4 weeks. Main risks: SFTP connector not ready, Okta SSO scoping unclear, saw latency at 8 concurrent users during POC. Assigning Maria as CSM and Nina for support triage. See owners + next steps below, please ack and pick up items.
Onboarding-Bot: Kickoff meeting scheduled Tue 2026-04-12 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent.
Maria (CSM): Ack. Thanks Sam. I'll own customer success/enablement. Kevin — can you start staging capacity prep for a dedicated pool? Need an initial perf baseline.
Kevin (CS Ops): On it. I'll provision a small dedicated pool in us-west staging. Need expected concurrency and typical batch sizes. Also confirm whether they'll use prefix caching.
Sam (Sales): Sharing quick config + POC notes:
``
account_id: oriondata-1337
sftp_host: sftp.orion-data.com
okta_tenant: orion.okta.com
notes: POC showed token spikes at ~8 conc users, otherwise fine.
```
Nina (Support): I'll own the integration tickets. Sam — can you open a support ticket with logs for the latency incident and attach sample requests? Also need SFTP creds when ready. I'll escalate any auth issues to Eng.
Maria (CSM): Owners consolidated: Maria (CSM) — enablement + weekly health; Kevin (CS Ops) — infra + staging; Nina (Support) — integration + triage; Ali (Eng) — engineering spike for Okta/KV if needed. Sam — you'll keep sales contact and commercial questions.
Ali (Eng): FYI I might need a quick spike to validate Okta handshake and check KV cache sizing for dedicated. If we get the SAML metadata + a test user I can aim for a 48h turnaround. Please open an RFC when you can.
Kevin (CS Ops): For perf baseline I'll run a 5m soak at 10, 25, 50 concurrent users and report p50/p90. Will need the expected QPS and average seq length.
Maria (CSM): Renewal watch — renewal in ~11 months. Flagging as moderate risk: if go-live slips >6 weeks or integration stalls, renewal sentiment could drop. I'll run weekly health checks and capture enablement feedback; please add product feedback to the thread so I can surface it in the next success review.
Nina (Support): Sam — can you also confirm whether customers will upload historical data to SFTP (size estimate)? That affects onboarding window.
Sam (Sales): They plan an initial bulk upload ~200GB within first week. I'll share upload timeline and SFTP creds by EOD.
Maria (CSM): Action items (owners):
- Sam: add SFTP creds + attach latency logs to support ticket (by EOD)
- Kevin: provision staging dedicated pool + perf tests (ETA 48h)
- Nina: open integration ticket + link to RFC if escalated (ETA 24h)
- Ali: standby for 48h engineering spike once RFC + metadata provided
- Maria: schedule weekly health check cadence, create onboarding checklist, track renewal sentiment
Please react when you've accepted your items.
Kevin (CS Ops): Accepted.
Nina (Support): Accepted.
Ali (Eng): Accepted — ping me when RFC created.
Sam (Sales): I'll create the SFDC handoff doc and post link here. tagging @Maria (CSM) @Nina (Support) for visibility :thumbsup:
Maria (CSM): Thanks all. I'll kick off the first health check after Kevin's perf report. If anyone runs into blockers, escalate in #eng-platform and add me.
